landing.eyebrow: Mobile vet · We come to you
landing.name: Dr Paws Calls
landing.tagline: Real veterinary care in your living room — less stress for pets, less hassle for you.
landing.heroHeadline: Call them. Care for them. At home.
landing.heroBody: Dr Paws Calls is mobile veterinary care with people who actually like your pet. House calls, wellness, vaccines, and the hard days too — calm, one-on-one, no waiting room.

services.heading: Care where they're comfortable
services.intro: House calls up front. Wellness, vaccines, and urgent visits when you need a vet who shows up.

items.label: House calls
items.description: Full veterinary visits at home — exam, treatment plan, and prescriptions without loading a stressed pet into the car.
prices: Multi-pet same address — ask when booking

items.label: Wellness & vaccines
items.description: Checkups, vaccines, and lab work coordinated around your schedule. We bring what we need and leave you a clear plan.

items.label: Urgent visits
items.description: Not an ER — but when something's off and you need a vet today, we triage by phone and come when it's safe to treat at home.

items.label: Senior & chronic care
items.description: Arthritis, diabetes, kidney disease — ongoing care plans with visits that respect how much your old friend can handle.
prices: Care plan — set at first visit

items.label: End-of-life care
items.description: Quality-of-life consults and humane euthanasia in the place your pet feels safest. We move slowly and answer every question.

about.heading: We're the humans behind the badge.
body: Dr Paws Calls takes a whole-pet approach: care that meets your animal where they're calmest — usually home. Fewer car rides, fewer waiting-room meltdowns, more time for the exam that actually matters.
We're built for mobile field service — real scheduling, real routes, real follow-up. You talk to the team that shows up, not a call center.
